bullets.text: Lego Batman Game Preview - **Traveller's Tales** brings a family-friendly yet respectful take on the Dark Knight.
iOS 27 Wallet Update - New 'Create a Pass' feature allows users to convert physical passes to digital.
Chrome AI Storage Issue - **Google Chrome** may consume 4GB of storage due to on-device AI model files.
QuTwo's Impressive Valuation - Finnish AI lab **QuTwo** reaches $380M valuation after a successful funding round.
AI-Powered Restaurant Launch - **Marc Lore** aims to let anyone create a restaurant brand using AI technology.
Nuro's Driverless Testing - **Nuro** receives permit for driverless testing of autonomous vehicles in California.
SAP's AI Investment - **SAP** plans to invest $1.16B in a German AI lab to enhance enterprise software.
Bumble's User Decline - **Bumble** reports a 21.1% drop in paying users as it prepares for a major overhaul.
Altara's Data Solutions - **Altara** secures $7M to streamline data management in physical sciences.
Lucid Motors Uncertainty - **Lucid Motors** is unsure of its EV production targets amid leadership changes.
